title: Solution Capability Mapping Schema
description: mappings/solution_capabilities.yaml — which solution capabilities each fetcher's evidence speaks to. GLOBAL and program-neutral: a capability maps to controls per program inside Paramify, so this file never names a control. Generated from the mapping sheet by tools/import_solcap_mapping.py; edit the sheet, then re-import. It is a SUGGESTION list for validator authoring: nothing is paired or attached from it on its own. Refreshed weekly by .github/workflows/solcap-mapping-refresh.yml; see docs/solcap_mapping_refresh.md.

source.description: Where the rows came from and when, so a stale import is visible in review.

fetcher.description: The fetcher's `name` from its fetcher.yaml (e.g. aws_auto_scaling_high_availability). Its evidence_set.reference_id is the set the pairs come from.

id.description: Library capability id (RS-02-03-01). Matched against a workspace capability's templateReferenceId, then its referenceId. Absent when the sheet row had none; the row can then only be name-matched, which always needs a person's approval.

name.description: The capability's name, without any ": <component>" suffix. Used to offer name-match candidates where the workspace carries no library ids.

ksis.description: The KSIs the sheet gave as the reason for this row. Context for a reviewer; nothing reads it to decide a pairing.
